candidates.title: Missing longitudinal multimodal human closure data
candidates.problem: Most evidence is mechanistic, cross-sectional, or exceptional-case based; repeated height velocity, MRI growth-plate state, endocrine state, and genetics are rarely aligned before closure.

candidates.title: No calibrated closure-readiness prediction protocol
candidates.problem: Chronological age and bone age are proxies, but an out-of-sample, subgroup-calibrated model for sustained cessation is not established by the registered evidence.

candidates.title: Cross-species causal overreach risk
candidates.problem: Animal estrogen and progenitor findings are often narrated as direct quantitative human mechanisms.

candidates.title: Intervention ethics and clinical applicability
candidates.problem: Direct endocrine manipulation or biopsy would not be an appropriate initial mechanism test in healthy minors.
